gloss: change of course; career path change

definitions.explanation: Changing the physical direction of travel, such as when driving, sailing, or flying.

definitions.gloss: career path change; change of future plans
definitions.explanation: Changing one's planned course in life, education, or career — such as switching from a university track to vocational school, or changing intended fields of study.

examples.japanese: {進路変更|しんろへんこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ウインカー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Use your turn signal when changing lanes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{進路変更|しんろへんこう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{東|ひがし}→東：02250_higashi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かった→向かう：01186_mukau⟧。
examples.english: The typhoon changed course and headed east.

examples.japanese: ⟦{安全|あんぜん}→安全：01131_anzen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}して→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{進路変更|しんろへんこう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please confirm it is safe before changing direction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高校|こうこう}→高校：01083_koukou⟧⟦{三年|さんねん}→三年：10984_sannen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{進路変更|しんろへんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: I decided to change my career path in the summer of my third year of high school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{留学|りゅうがく}→留学：03677_ryuugaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{進路変更|しんろへんこう}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Studying abroad led me to change my career plans.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{進路変更|しんろへんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}したら→相談する：01845_soudansuru⟧、⟦{応援|おうえん}して→応援する：21988_ouensuru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: When I consulted my parents about changing my career path, they were supportive.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{進路|しんろ}→進路：14321_shinro⟧ (course; route; career path) + ⟦{変更|へんこう}→変更：03616_henkou⟧ (change). The word has two distinct spheres of usage: physical navigation and life planning. In the driving context, it specifically refers to lane changes and turns. In the life-planning context, it is closely tied to the Japanese education system, where students must choose their ⟦{進路|しんろ}→進路：14321_shinro⟧ (future path) during high school.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {進路変更|しんろへんこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: change course / change career path
- {進路変更|しんろへんこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{合図|あいず}→合図：01675_aizu⟧: signal for a direction change
- {進路変更|しんろへんこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: decide on a change of course

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{方向転換|ほうこうてんかん}→方向転換：15617_houkoutenkan⟧: change of direction — more dramatic; implies a major shift
- ⟦{転職|てんしょく}→転職：04557_tenshoku⟧: job change — specifically about switching jobs, not the broader life-course meaning
- {志望変更|しぼうへんこう}: change of desired school/career — more specific to application targets
